Hi Sam — great to meet today, thanks for the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side: 

What we heard:
- You want to start with a 3-node pilot (low-volume) for the recommender flows.
- Procurement will likely prefer a PO for production; card may be acceptable for a short pilot if finance prefers.
- Security needs SOC 2 evidence and a short data-handling FAQ.

Our proposed mutual action plan (MAP):
1) We’ll send a pricing workbook and an MPA template for legal review — Hannah (today) — attachment: Redwood_MVP_Pricing.xlsx.
2) You share the procurement intake form + primary procurement contact — Sam (by EOD Tue).
3) Security checklist + SOC2 artifacts to your security team — Ben (48h).
4) Target: legal review complete and finance OK for PO issuance within 3-4 weeks if no material redlines.

Questions for you (short):
- Do you have an existing marketplace preference (AWS Marketplace / Azure / none)?
- Who is the named finance approver for POs (name/email)?

I’ll attach the pricing workbook now. If card for pilot is preferable, we can enable that quickly and keep PO for the production roll.

Thanks — looking forward to next steps.

— Hannah Schmitt
Head of GTM Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Thanks Hannah — useful recap. A few notes from procurement/ops: 

- Marketplace: we prefer marketplace options when possible (AWS Marketplace first). That can speed procurement for small pilots, but our procurement group will still want a PO for production.
- Finance contact: Emily Nguyen (emily.nguyen@acmecorp.com) — she handles vendor POs for our product org.
- Timeline: if legal review is straightforward (no major IP / indemnity asks) we typically see a 2-4 week window to PO issuance; security review can be a gating factor.

Requesting security package and SOC2 report to security@acmecorp.com — please include a short one-page data-handling FAQ. Also attaching our procurement intake form for your reference.

Sam
VP, Product Operations
Acme Corporation

- We will send the SOC 2 Type II summary and a 1-page data handling FAQ to security@acmecorp.com by EOD tomorrow.
- For PO vs card: we can support both. Recommended approach: card for a 30-day pilot (faster), PO for production. If you want a PO for the pilot we can accommodate but it may add 1-2 weeks.
- Marketplace: we can work with AWS Marketplace; that typically shortens procurement for smaller pilots but has invoicing flow differences. Happy to map the exact AMI/offer details if you want.
